Title: Add a new customer successfully
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Add Customer tab
2. Enter First Name, Last Name, Post Code
3. Click Add Customer
Test Data: First Name: Tanzeela; Last Name: Shaik; Post Code: DXB001
Expected Result: Confirmation message displayed: "Customer added successfully with customer id :<id>"

Title: Add customer with missing mandatory field
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Add Customer tab
2. Leave Last Name blank
3. Click Add Customer
Test Data: First Name: Tanzeela; Last Name: (blank); Post Code: DXB001
Expected Result: Form does not submit / customer is not created

Title: Open a Dollar account for an existing customer
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Open Account tab
2. Select customer from dropdown
3. Select currency: Dollar
4. Click Process
Expected Result: Confirmation message displayed: "Account created successfully with account Number :<number>"

Title: Verify newly onboarded customer appears in client directory
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Customers tab
2. Search customer by last name
Expected Result: Customer row displayed with correct First Name / Last Name / Post Code

Title: Delete a customer record
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Customers tab
2. Locate customer row
3. Click Delete
Expected Result: Customer row removed from the directory

Title: Deposit funds into an account
Preconditions: Customer logged in with an active account
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Deposit tab
2. Enter amount
3. Click Deposit
Expected Result: "Deposit Successful" message displayed; account balance increases by the deposited amount

Title: Withdraw funds within available balance
Preconditions: Customer logged in; balance >= withdrawal amount
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Withdrawl tab
2. Enter amount within balance
3. Click Withdraw
Expected Result: "Transaction successful" message displayed; account balance decreases by the withdrawn amount

Title: Reject withdrawal exceeding available balance
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Withdrawl tab
2. Enter amount greater than balance
3. Click Withdraw
Expected Result: "Transaction Failed. You can not withdraw amount more than the balance." displayed; balance unchanged

Title: Verify transaction history reflects a deposit as Credit
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Transactions tab
2. Locate the deposit entry
Expected Result: Row displayed with correct date-time, amount, and type = Credit

Title: Verify transaction history reflects a withdrawal as Debit
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Transactions tab
2. Locate the withdrawal entry
Expected Result: Row displayed with correct date-time, amount, and type = Debit

Title: Verify account balance matches sum of transaction history
Test Steps:
1. Sum all Credit/Debit entries in Transactions tab
2. Compare to displayed account balance
Expected Result: Displayed balance equals (total credits - total debits)

Title: Verify currency selected at account opening is reflected on customer dashboard
Preconditions: Account opened with a specific currency (TC_03)
Test Steps:
1. Log in as the customer
2. View account summary
Expected Result: Account summary displays the same currency selected at account opening
